title: Mock Test

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.
I have left it to his discretion to accept or decline my offer
questions.solution:
D) Discretion(noun) – The quality of behaving or speaking in such a way as to avoid causing offense or revealing private information; the freedom to decide what should be done in a particular situation. विवेक
Antonym:Inattention(noun) – Lack of attention; negligence, carelessness, disregard. लापरवाही

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
The athlete looked unsettled before the race.
questions.solution:
D)Unsettled(adjective) – Anxious, nervous, disturbed, restless. बेचैन
Antonym:Confident(adjective) – Feeling or showing confidence in oneself or one's abilities or qualities, self-assured, assured, positive. आत्मविश्वासी

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
The waters of Germany are abundant in fish, but there are few genera and species in them.
questions.solution:
D)Abundant(adjective) – Plentiful, copious, ample, rich. प्रचुर
Antonym:Deficient(adjective) – Lacking, insufficient, inadequate, scanty. अभावग्रस्त/ अपूर्ण

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Compulsory
questions.solution:
A) Compulsory (adjective)– Required by law or a rule; obligatory. अनिवार्य
Antonym:Optional(adjective) – Available to be chosen but not obligatory; voluntary, elective. वैकल्पिक

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the given word.
Ghastly
questions.solution:
D)Ghastly(adjective) – Horrifying, dreadful, shocking, frightful. भयावह
Antonym:Pleasant(adjective) – Giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment, delightful, pleasing. सुखद

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Queer
questions.solution:
C)Queer(adjective) – Strange, odd, unusual, peculiar. अजीब
Antonym:Ordinary(adjective) – Normal, usual, regular, conventional. सामान्य

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘Contaminate’ from the given sentence.
Crews were requested to purify the system since a brain-eating amoeba was discovered in the drinking water.
questions.solution:
A) Contaminate(verb) – To make something impure by exposure to or addition of a poisonous or polluting substance. दूषित करना
Antonym:Purify(verb) – To remove contaminants from, make clean or pure. शुद्ध करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
I left the job because of a hostile working environment
questions.solution:
B)Hostile(adjective) – Unfriendly, antagonistic, aggressive. शत्रुतापूर्ण
Antonym:Friendly(adjective) – Kind, pleasant, amiable, affable. मैत्रीपूर्ण

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Precarious
questions.solution:
B) Precarious(adjective) – Not securely held or in position; dangerously likely to fall or collapse, uncertain, insecure. अनिश्चित
Antonym:Reliable(adjective) – Consistently good in quality or performance; able to be trusted, dependable. विश्वसनीय

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
The vendor said that the apples were of superior quality.
questions.solution:
C) Superior(adjective) – Higher in rank, status, or quality, excellent, better, higher. उत्तम
Antonym:Inferior(adjective) – Lower in rank, status, or quality, poorer, lower, substandard. निम्न

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
He is not friendly with him in the office
questions.solution: C)Friendly(adjective) – Kind, pleasant, and supportive. मित्रतापूर्णAntonym:Hostile(adjective) – Unfriendly, antagonistic, aggressive. शत्रुतापूर्ण

questions.question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
He worked alone as he did not want anyone to hamper his project
questions.solution:
A)Hamper(verb) – to hinder, obstruct, or impede the progress of something. बाधा डालना
Antonym:Help(verb) – to assist, support, or make it easier for someone to do something. मदद करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Abandon
questions.solution:
A)Abandon(verb) – To leave behind, to desert, to give up completely. त्यागना
Antonym:Adopt(verb) – To take up, follow, or use, to legally take as one's own child. अपनाना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.
You can’t stop the _________ (outflow) of current
questions.solution:
C) Outflow (noun)– The action or process of flowing out, especially in a large quantity; discharge, efflux, outpouring. प्रवाह/बहिर्वाह
Antonym:Influx (noun)– An arrival or entry of large numbers of people or things; inflow, arrival, introduction. आवक/अंतर्वाही

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘Commence’ from the given sentence.
Let’s put an end to this discussion about voodoo and instead talk about something amusing
questions.solution:
B) Commence(verb) – To begin, start, initiate, inaugurate. प्रारंभ करना
Antonym:End(verb) – To stop, finish, conclude, terminate. समाप्त करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Impulsive
questions.solution:
C) Impulsive(adjective) – Acting or done without forethought, spontaneous, rash, hasty. आवेगशील
Antonym:Cautious(adjective) – Careful to avoid potential problems or dangers, prudent, vigilant, deliberate. सावधान

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Massive
questions.solution:
B) Massive(adjective) – Large, huge, immense, enormous. विशाल
Antonym:Tiny(adjective) – Very small, minute, diminutive. छोटा
